events.name: Slow Burn Theatre Co: Roald Dahl's Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
events.venue: Amaturo Theater at Broward Center, Ft Lauderdale
events.description: This fantastical musical follows young Charlie Bucket and his Grandpa Joe as they join four other Golden Ticket winners to tour the magical and mysterious chocolate factory of eccentric "Candy Man" Willy Wonka. When the factory gates are opened, experience the lifechanging journey through a world of "Pure Imagination," revealed with Wonka's army of curious "Oompa-Loompas." Who will win the lifetime supply of chocolate? STEP BEHIND THE GATES AND DISCOVER WHAT AWAITS. $30 Lap Tickets are available for purchase for children 12 months and under and only available at the Broward Center's AutoNation
